From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Cc: CloudPartner Solutions <psales@cloudpartner.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private Control Plane — operator identity governance & SAML/SCIM sprint sync

Team / Acme folks —

Kicking off a short sprint to finalize operator identity governance and the SAML/SCIM integration for the Private Control Plane deployment (VPC/on-prem) for Acme. Goal: a deployable runbook + attributes contract, cert rotation windows, and SCIM rate/consistency expectations by end of next week.

Attachments: privcp-sprint-plan.xlsx (timeline + owner matrix), initial SAML attribute mapping (we want your mapping confirmed), sample SCIM payload.

Primary asks for this thread: 
- Acme: confirm the SAML attribute names and whether you can expose groupMembership (we currently require operator:admin, operator:viewer claims)
- Acme: confirm certificate rotation window (30/60/90 day) and whether we can schedule a test rotation during the cutover
- Internal: decide audit/entitlement cadence (daily delta vs. per-request reconciliation) and any temporary operator elevation policy for oncall

Proposed #1 sync: Wed 2026-09-01 10:00 PT — 30 min. If that works I’ll send a calendar invite with the sprint board link.

Notes: we will prefer a SCIM delta feed every 15–30 minutes for operator lists to keep operator sessions short; if Acme has strict rate limits we can fall back to a daily reconciliation plus prefix caching in the control plane (longer TTL).

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin
Sr. PM, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: privcp-sprint-plan.xlsx (18kb)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Private Control Plane — operator identity governance & SAML/SCIM sprint sync

Thanks Marcus — I can make the Wed 10:00 PT slot. Quick clarifications: 

- From an audit perspective we need a daily snapshot (UTC midnight) of operator bindings exported to the customer audit bundle. That doesn’t preclude 15–30 minute SCIM deltas for runtime enforcement, but we should be explicit in the runbook.
- For operator elevation (oncall temporary admin) I propose a 1-hour JIT elevation window tied to a ticket ID, audited and auto-revoked. We’ll add the flow to the runbook and the RBAC matrix.

I’m attaching a suggested SAML attribute mapping CSV with our recommended attribute names and examples — please have Acme confirm names and casing.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Technical Program Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference

Hi Marcus / Laura / team —

Thanks for the plan and the mapping file. A few answers from Acme SSO team: 

- We are able to provide groupMembership on the SAML assertion under attribute name memberOf (case-sensitive). We will emit operator roles as an array (e.g., ["operator:admin", "operator:viewer"]) in the memberOf claim.
- Certificate rotation: default cadence is 90 days, but we can support a 30-day test rotation for cutover testing if Redwood can schedule the rotation outside our primary backup window (Tue 02:00–04:00 PT).
- SCIM: we currently allow 600 requests/minute from integrations; delta feeds are supported. We recommend a 1s burst capacity but will throttle sustained traffic to 200 req/min. For the first cutover week we can temporarily bump to 400 req/min with CloudPartner’s assistance.

We’ll confirm a sample assertion and the SCIM delta payload by EOD today (attached scim-sample-payload.json). For the mapping, please confirm whether Redwood expects hashed identifiers or plain emails for subjectId — our default is stable immutable subjectId (GUID), and we can include email as an attribute.

Regards,
Priya Sharma
Identity Engineer — Acme Corp
idp-admin@acme.com

[Attachment: scim-sample-payload.json (6kb)]

Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2026 14:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private Control Plane — operator identity governance & SAML/SCIM sprint sync

Thanks Priya — this is great and very actionable. Agreed on the following decisions for the sprint: 

- Attribute contract: use memberOf array for operator roles; Redwood will accept GUID subjectId and will store email as a secondary attribute. We’ll add mapping examples to the runbook.
- Cert rotation: test rotation scheduled for Wed 2026-09-08 03:00 PT (outside Acme window). Marcus/Jordan to own runbook step and rollback plan.
- SCIM capacity: Redwood will implement delta polling at 15-minute cadence for normal operation and fall back to 1-hour full reconciliation if we detect sustained 429s. For cutover week Acme to allow a temporary 400 req/min cap; CloudPartner will coordinate if any proxy changes are required.
- Audit/export: daily UTC snapshot for customer audit bundle + per-event audit logs retained for 90 days in the private control plane.

Action items (owners):
- Jordan Blake: update runbook with JIT elevation flow, audit snapshot step, and cert rotation rollback (due 2026-09-04)
- Marissa Cole: add SCIM throttle handling to the control plane client and test with Acme sample payload (due 2026-09-06)
- Marcus Lin: schedule cutover test rotation and send calendar invite (scheduled 2026-09-08 03:00 PT)

I’ll create PRIV-187 with the final runbook link and upload the mappings to the shared Drive. If nobody objects I’ll send the invite and the sprint board access tonight.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Sr. PM, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
